title: Uskurait becomes CO; Waller XO; Pape S-3

paragraphs.text: Major L. W. T. WALLER, II, was relieved as Commanding Officer by Lieutenant Colonel R. H. USKURAIT. Major L. W. T. WALLER, II, became the Executive Of- ficer. Major R. A. PAPE became the S-3.
